author: UsersHammer
description: Playful mock-moderation for regular members. Users can banish, remove, silence, or chatmute others with typical moderator-style lines. Nothing is actually banned, kicked, muted, or timed out. Staff can add responses, post a fake modlog, and toggle a 1-in-5 backfire chance. Command names default to banish/remove/silence/chatmute so they do not clash with Red's real ban, kick, mute, or timeout commands.
short: Playful fake ban/kick/mute/timeout responses for members.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store end user data. Guild staff may save custom joke response templates, command aliases, and a fake modlog channel ID for the server. Those settings are not tied to a user ID.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing UsersHammer.

This cog is **roleplay only**. It never bans, kicks, mutes, or times anyone out.

Default member commands (safe names that do not replace core Mod/Mutes):
`[p]banish`    mock ban
`[p]remove`    mock kick
`[p]silence`   mock mute
`[p]chatmute`  mock timeout

Staff setup: `[p]help uhset`
Fake modlog: `[p]uhset modlog channel #channel`
Backfire: `[p]uhset backfire`
Overview: `[p]help UsersHammer`
